{"shared_passages":[{"question_numbers":[16,17],"text":"M: Welcome back to the Music and Life course. Songs are known to have several functions. Today, we’re learning about how songs are used at a variety of places to create group unity. First, people sing songs together in sports stadiums. Most sports teams have unique fight songs that their fans sing to express connection to the team, which works as a kind of musical uniform that unites fans. Second, the use of songs promotes group identity at schools. Students sing their school song together during important events, which helps share common values and develops a sense of unity. Next, soldiers sing songs at military bases. While they march and train, they sing their military songs together. Through this process, they build group bonds and develop into one unified force. Finally, people are brought together by work songs on farms. When people sing songs together while working on farms, they feel connected to one another and gain a sense of unity. Now, let’s listen to some example songs."}],"questions":[{"number":13,"question":"대화를 듣고, 남자의 마지막 말에 대한 여자의 응답으로 가장 적절한 것을 고르시오. [3점]","context":"M: Hey, Alice. W: Thanks. I think we need to bring something to eat and drink.
M: We don’t have to. There are many food stands selling various foods like pizza or fried chicken at the stadium.
W: Fantastic. Do they have instant noodles, too? If they don’t, I’d like to bring some.
M: Actually, instant noodles are not allowed in the stadium. It’s because hot water can be dangerous.
W: That makes sense. Then, are there other items we shouldn’t bring?
M: There are, but I can’t remember them all. It would be better to look them up on the stadium website.

As she walked into her classroom, she heard a familiar voice. Sarah was calling her name. “Katie, I’m sorry for the things I said yesterday.” A big smile spread across Katie’s face. “I’m sorry, too. If we can enhance lifelong learning initiatives, we will not only promote personal growth and well-being but also sustain national productivity and global competitiveness. Furthermore, our efforts will support social integration by providing opportunities for people from various backgrounds to connect and move on together.
